name: Psychometry
description: Psychometry is the alleged paranormal ability to obtain information about an object's history — its past owners, locations, or events surrounding it — by physical contact. The term was coined by American physician Joseph Rodes Buchanan in 1842.
origin: Practised principally in 19th- and 20th-century Anglosphere Spiritualism and 20th-century European parapsychology, though similar 'reading-from-objects' practices appear in many divinatory traditions worldwide.
